task.question: Do frozen cross-round transition and season-conditioned signals add genuinely independent number rankings beyond the seven B components?
task.novelty: Pre-outcome screening of three prespecified transition/season conditional signal families by rank-to-selection correlation and same-target Jaccard; no outcomes enter the independence screen.

spec.research_question: Do frozen cross-round transition and season-conditioned signals add genuinely independent number rankings beyond the seven B components?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: For target t, all signal counts and the prior-round state use only rounds 1..t-1; transition labels stop at t-1.
spec.primary_metric: mean absolute candidate-rank to B-ticket-membership correlation and mean same-target top-six Jaccard
spec.comparator: same-target seven frozen B component tickets plus combined_equal_rank
spec.baseline: B-redundancy thresholds are fixed at mean |correlation| <0.20, mean Jaccard <0.20, and max component mean Jaccard <0.35
spec.multiplicity_correction: No outcome-based hypothesis tests are used for the geometry-only screen; all three prespecified signals are reported.
spec.tie_break: descending frozen signal score, then lower number
spec.novelty_signature: cross-round Markov transition matrix; calendar-season conditional incidence; fixed previous-draw-sum-regime conditional incidence; B rank-membership correlation and top-six Jaccard screen
